## Definition of Done

Full checklist: [docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md](../docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

- [ ] `golangci-lint run` clean (or `//nolint` with reason)
- [ ] `go vet ./...` clean, no new govulncheck findings
- [ ] No secrets, keys or session data committed
- [ ] CI green
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` / `docs/` / godoc)
